cases.title: Portfolio renamed after the version was assembled

expect.about: designation names “Lumen Segregated Portfolio”; the registry now says “Lumen Growth Segregated Portfolio”

cases.why: The check compares against the current records, not the slot snapshot, so a version assembled before a rename cannot reach READY_FOR_SUBMISSION. The fix is to re-assemble, which creates a new version (INV-3).
